items.zh: 考古学家在阿拉斯加一处拥有 13,800 年历史的遗址中发现了西半球最古老的住宅

items.title: Physicists froze a 'necklace' of atoms — and witnessed a quantum phenomenon predicted 100 years ago
items.summary: Atoms confined to a single line can bind into clusters called Bethe strings. A new experiment points to a mix of many such clusters, though the evidence is still indirect.
items.zh: 物理学家冻结了一条原子“项链”——并目睹了 100 年前预测的量子现象

items.title: Horned dinosaurs’ weapons evolved to handle the forces of combat
items.summary: New simulations reveal which battle moves the skulls of horned dinosaurs could take — and which might have been a very bad idea.
items.zh: 有角恐龙的武器是为了应对战斗力量而进化的

items.title: Fossil of 'unconquered female warrior' dinosaur with long claws found in UK museum drawer after 100 years
items.summary: The newly identified Invictibellatrix amberina lived about 120 million years ago and represents the first megaraptoran dinosaur found in Europe, according to a new study.
items.zh: 100年后在英国博物馆抽屉里发现“不可征服的女战士”长爪恐龙化石

items.title: He Wants AI Benchmarking To Be a Science, Not a Dark Art
items.summary: Moritz Hardt, author of a new book on benchmarks, believes these “standardized tests” for artificial intelligence are fundamentally broken — but not unfixable. The post He Wants AI Benchmarking To Be a Science, Not a Dark Art first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 他希望人工智能基准测试成为一门科学，而不是一门黑暗艺术

items.title: Artemis II results show how much science people can do at the moon
items.summary: We’ve studied the moon with robotic spacecraft for decades. What do human observers add? Artemis II’s first science results offer some answers.
items.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯二号的结果显示了人们在月球上可以做多少科学工作

items.title: The uranium cubes that exposed Nazi Germany’s nuclear failure
items.summary: Scientists investigating Nazi Germany's secret nuclear program have uncovered evidence that its final experimental reactor was nowhere near as close to working as previously claimed. Analysis of surviving uranium cubes and wartime documents reveals that Germany lacked the enormous quantities of uran
items.zh: 揭露纳粹德国核失败的铀立方

items.title: Crossword: Time lines
items.summary: Solve the crossword from our November 2026 issue, in which we cultivate an understanding of growth curves.
items.zh: 填字游戏：时间线

items.title: Astronomers discover the first-ever green star, plus the reddest 'white dwarf' ever seen
items.summary: Stellar remnants called white dwarfs ‪appear to come in a rainbow of colors, according to a new study.
items.zh: 天文学家发现了有史以来第一颗绿色恒星，以及有史以来最红的“白矮星”

items.title: NASA captures strange waves high above Hurricane Simon
items.summary: As Hurricane Simon unleashed destructive winds and flooding along Mexico’s coast, NASA satellites captured an extraordinary sight: massive atmospheric waves rippling high above the storm. The rare images reveal how powerful hurricanes can disturb the upper atmosphere, creating patterns that are usua
items.zh: 美国宇航局在飓风西蒙上方捕捉到奇怪的波浪

items.title: A protein that fuels cancer could also be the key to fighting it
items.summary: Scientists have discovered how to turn a protein that normally fuels cancer growth into a weapon against it. By activating PPARD in immune cells, researchers made them better at burning fat and attacking tumors, slowing or stopping cancer growth in laboratory experiments. The approach showed promise
items.zh: 一种促进癌症的蛋白质也可能是对抗癌症的关键

items.title: “Crawzilla” was huge. Then scientists found an even bigger crayfish
items.summary: A nationwide search for giant crayfish uncovered a record-breaking Tennessee specimen and a surprising mystery about how big these freshwater creatures can grow. Scientists found that North American crayfish seem to hit a biological size limit, possibly because of their muscles or protective shells.
items.zh: “Crawzilla”很大。然后科学家发现了一种更大的小龙虾

items.title: Antarctica’s sea ice has undergone a stunning reversal
items.summary: Antarctic sea ice reached its third-lowest winter maximum in 2026, extending a remarkable decline that began after years of record-breaking growth. Scientists are investigating whether the dramatic reversal signals a long-term shift in Antarctica's frozen landscape.
items.zh: 南极洲的海冰发生了惊人的逆转

items.title: State of Supply Chain Sustainability Report finds corporate commitment at record high, but governance lags behind
items.summary: MIT's Center for Transportation and Logistics finds sustainability commitments are strong, but governance gaps and external disruptions prevent execution.
items.zh: 供应链可持续发展状况报告发现企业承诺创历史新高，但治理滞后

items.title: AI model decodes the language cells use to communicate
items.summary: A new computational approach reveals how cells communicate to assemble into tissues. This could accelerate stem cell engineering, improve disease models, and inform therapies.
items.zh: 人工智能模型解码用于交流的语言细胞

items.title: 2 giant Ramesses II statues, one wearing a double crown, discovered by man in Egypt
items.summary: The remains of two Ramesses II statues — one of which would have originally stood around 28 feet tall — were found by a villager in Egypt.
items.zh: 埃及人发现了两座巨型拉美西斯二世雕像，其中一尊戴着双王冠

items.title: What did the Liberty Bell sound like? Science is on the case.
items.summary: Researchers hunted for clues in modal analysis of 20th-century replica bell at Penn State Behrend.
items.zh: 自由钟听起来是什么样的？科学正在研究这个案例。

items.title: Microplastics in water aren’t inert and make damaging chemicals on their own
items.summary: Its effect on people remains an ongoing question.
items.zh: 水中的微塑料不具有惰性，会自行产生有害化学物质

items.title: Satellite data reveal how Antarctica’s ice cliffs behave over time
items.summary: The cliffs don’t always collapse in the runaway process that scientists had expected.
items.zh: 卫星数据揭示了南极洲冰崖随时间的变化

items.title: Many American diets may not include enough of this essential nutrient
items.summary: With the proliferation of fancy salts and changing dietary habits, there are signs people aren’t getting enough of the crucial mineral iodine.
items.zh: 许多美国人的饮食可能没有包含足够的这种必需营养素

items.title: Neutron's first launch slips again amid trouble with carbon composites
items.summary: Rocket Lab announced the Neutron rocket in 2021, aiming for a first flight in 2024.
items.zh: 由于碳复合材料的问题，Neutron 的首次发射再次陷入困境

items.title: 'We're not a competitor to fusion. We are fusion': Inside the race to harness unlimited solar power in space
items.summary: Space-based solar power has the potential to meet Earth's energy needs many times over. Will it see the light of day?
items.zh: “我们不是核聚变的竞争对手。我们正在融合”：在太空中利用无限太阳能的竞赛

items.title: Rewilding could help vulnerable islands keep pace with rising seas
items.summary: Seabirds, native plants, and healthy reefs can help atolls build as seas rise.
items.zh: 重新野化可以帮助脆弱的岛屿跟上海平面上升的步伐

items.title: A telling hole in a Neandertal bone hints at a bitter end
items.summary: An excavation at an iconic Neandertal burial site uncovers evidence for one individual's potential fatal wound as well as an injury endured for years.
items.zh: 尼安德特人骨头上的一个明显的洞暗示着痛苦的结局

items.title: Building trust in governments through digital platforms
items.summary: Governments and private companies often work together to provide public services online. A new study asks: How do these partnerships affect people’s trust in government?
items.zh: 通过数字平台建立对政府的信任

items.title: How Do Fungi Keep the Planet Healthy?
items.summary: Evolutionary biologist Toby Kiers explains how fungal networks in soil trade nutrients with plants, help keep carbon underground, and strike bargains without having a brain. The post How Do Fungi Keep the Planet Healthy? first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 真菌如何保持地球健康？

items.title: Brain implants are helping people who’ve lost their voice
items.summary: The technology could get those with ALS, Parkinson’s disease and brain injuries “talking” again.
items.zh: 大脑植入物正在帮助失去声音的人

items.title: Arctic sea ice hits another troubling low in 2026
items.summary: Arctic sea ice is shrinking in both winter and summer, with satellite records revealing that the region's remaining ice is becoming thinner, younger, and more vulnerable to melting. Despite a recent slowdown in summer losses, scientists warn that the Arctic could experience a nearly ice-free summer
items.zh: 2026 年北极海冰再创新低，令人不安

items.title: Q&A: The “collision” between AI, your brain, and society
items.summary: In a new book, Professor Eric So explores how the technology affects our thinking skills.
items.zh: Q&A：AI、你的大脑、社会的“碰撞”

items.title: Things are finally looking up for NASA's first missions to Venus in a generation
items.summary: "This is great news for us. We're staffing up. We're accelerating."
items.zh: 美国宇航局一代人以来首次金星任务的情况终于有了好转
